summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (JTM 2.7/13)

data.turoyo: Maḥtiwo u baṣro b gawe w mqapṭiwole hawxa, bat tarte iḏoṯo <...>
data.translation: Sie gaben das Fleisch hinein und verschlossen (die Teigtasche) so mit beiden Händen. <...>

rationale: New Infectum-wa box; explicit dough closure with both hands.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (MAC NE interview 1/5)

data.turoyo: <...> Ŭ mqapṭéwayna ha xud uʕdo, mqapṭéwayna, dəsmalat ʕal qarʕayna, aǧ+ǧule hawxa yarixe aʕlayna. <...>
data.translation: <...> And we would be covered up just like now, we would be covered up, scarfs upon our heads, the clothes so long upon us. <...>

rationale: Thin Detransitive Part. Pass. cell; plural clothed state with past copula.

data.turoyo: <...> w səmmalle sanduqo me zafto, w maḥatte u zʕuro bu sanduqo w mqapaṭṭe aʕle, maḥattalle muklone b gawe w marfalle bu baḥar di walaye du Yaman.
data.translation: <...> Sie machten ihm eine verpichte Kiste, legten den Jungen in die Kiste, verschlossen sie hinter ihm, legten Essen für ihn hinein und ließen sie ins Meer der Stadt Jemen hinab.

rationale: Thin Preterit cell; container closure around a person and assimilated plural agent ending.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (64/124)

data.turoyo: Bəṯr gədmoṭat li darga, arbʕi dargat ne. ʕəsri mənne ftiḥe ne w ʕəsri mənne mqapṭe ne.
data.translation: Dann wirst du an das Tor kommen. Es sind vierzig Tore; zwanzig davon sind offen und zwanzig sind geschlossen.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Part. Pass. cell; overt plural predication contrasting open and closed.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (64/125)

data.turoyo: A mqapṭe gfətḥatte w a ḥrene gṣəxratte.
data.translation: Die geschlossenen mußt du öffnen und die anderen mußt du schließen.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Part. Pass. cell; substantivized plural result state.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (96/128)

data.turoyo: <...> at tarʕayḏan ṣxire w mqapṭe w lo gəmšaylat. <...>
data.translation: <...> Unsere Türen sind verschlossen und verriegelt, und du fragst nicht danach. -

rationale: Fifth Detransitive Part. Pass. example; coordination with ṣxire.

summary: Turkish kapatmak is integrated into the existing II paradigm as a lexical verb. Dough, chest and envelope closure remain sense 1, not light-verb collocations.

JTM 2.7/13 adds Infectum-wa: mqapṭiwole has the 3pl finite ending and suffixed dough patient. By contrast mqapṭéwayna in MAC NE interview 1/5 is a plural Part. Pass. with a past copula and clothed state holders; keep it under Detransitive Part. Pass.

The Part. Pass. appears attributively with a bridge, predicatively with doors/gates and clothed people, and substantivized as 'the closed ones' at 64/125. These are distributional functions, not new senses.

Chest closure at 60/38 has an implicit container object and aʕle referring to the enclosed boy. ṭ+l assimilation yields mqapaṭṭe. The coordinated ṣxire w mqapṭe in 96/128 is useful contact evidence without proving a distinct meaning of either conjunct.
Confirm that mqapṭéwayna in the clothing description is Part. Pass. plus past copula; the plural covered-state reading is used here.
Does the coordination ṣxire w mqapṭe at 96/128 distinguish locking from closing, or reinforce one state? This context alone cannot establish a new numbered sense.
Restore the missing n in dann.
rationale: The supplied JL translation has und dann füllen; dan is a misspelling of the temporal adverb.

summary: Correct the article in der Klösse.
rationale: Klösse is plural and requires genitive der, not singular des. The supplied edition has der Klöße; preserve the glossary’s ss spelling.

summary: The covering/closing state applies to clothed people, gates and doors, alongside the inherited covered bridge; no separate sense is needed.
